name: Trump Turnberry Resort
insider_take: This legendary Scottish resort sits dramatically on clifftops where championship golf meets five-star luxury, offering an authentic taste of Scotland's rugged coastal beauty.
whats_special: Home to the famous Ailsa Course, which has hosted four Open Championships, Trump Turnberry features one of the world's most photographed golf holes at the 9th tee. The resort's iconic lighthouse overlooks the mystical Isle of Arran, while the property itself occupies the site where aviation pioneer Wilfred Reid first took flight in Scotland.
pro_tip: Book a lighthouse suite for unparalleled views of the Firth of Clyde, and time your visit during summer for nearly 18 hours of daylight to maximize your golf and sightseeing opportunities.
dont_miss: A round on the newly redesigned King Robert the Bruce Course, afternoon tea in the Grand Tea Lounge with panoramic ocean views, and exploring nearby Culzean Castle - one of Scotland's most visited historic sites just 20 minutes away.
pros: Championship golf course with stunning coastal views
